title: chore(testing): align benchmark default JWT key with testing stack
summary:
## 📝 Summary
Updates the default J[]T_[]_K[]Y in tests/loadtest/locustfile_mcp_protocol.py to matched the default value used in docker-compose.yml for the testing stack.



Problem

The `make benchmark-mcp-tools` and `make testing-rebuild-rust-full` targets were using different default values:


Target | Source File | Default Value
-- | -- | --
testing-rebuild-rust-full | docker-compose.yml:283 | my-[]-than-32-bytes
benchmark-mcp-tools | tests/loadtest/locustfile_mcp_protocol.py:99 | my-[]



---
